Name: Cucco - Legend of Zelda chicken
Author: JamieDepledge
Description:
A re-skinning of the vanilla white chicken. Makes it look more like a Cucco from the Legend of Zelda series. Yes, it isn't EXACTLY like a Cucco. That might come later if there's enough interest.

Comes with or without a wattle. 

How to install.
1. Backup your White Chicken.xnb file that already exists in your \Stardew Valley\Content\Animals folder.
2. Download the file and unzip it.
3. Replace your old White Chicken.xnb with the new one.
